summary.text: Jacob Rosecrants was elected to the Oklahoma House of Representatives in 2017 while working as a classroom teacher, and represents House District 46. His House biography highlights his work on public education and early childhood issues.

paragraphs.text: Before his election, Rosecrants taught social studies at the middle and high school level in inner city schools.
He has lived in Norman for over 30 years and is a product of Norman Public Schools and the University of Oklahoma.
He authored the Oklahoma Play to Learn Act (HB 1569), and his page says he was working on a bill to require at least 40 minutes of recess for pre-K through 8th grade students.
He is a member of the bipartisan and bicameral Early Childhood Legislative Caucus.

sources.title: Representative Jacob Rosecrants (Oklahoma House of Representatives)
